name: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY)
department: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
summary: World's largest health insurance scheme, giving eligible families cashless treatment worth ₹5 lakh per year at empanelled hospitals.
eligibility: Rural households meeting SECC-2011 deprivation criteria (e.g. kutcha housing, no adult earning member, disabled member with no able-bodied adult)
Urban households in specified occupational categories under SECC-2011
All senior citizens aged 70 and above, regardless of income category, get an additional ₹5 lakh cover
fee: Free — no premium is paid by the beneficiary
process: Check eligibility on the PM-JAY portal or via the Ayushman App using your ration card or mobile number
Complete Aadhaar-based e-KYC to generate your Ayushman Card
Download or collect the Ayushman Card from a Common Service Centre or empanelled hospital's Ayushman Mitra desk
Present the card at any empanelled hospital for cashless treatment up to the annual limit

faq.question: How much health cover does PM-JAY provide?
faq.answer: ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation. Senior citizens 70+ get an additional ₹5 lakh, on top of any existing family cover.

faq.question: Do I need to pay anything to enrol?
faq.answer: No. Enrolment and treatment under PM-JAY are completely free for eligible beneficiaries at empanelled hospitals.
